title: Wiggly Caterpillar Craft Kit
summary: Make a giggly paper chain caterpillar: pre-cut strips, googly eyes, pipe cleaners and a printed face.
description:
Pre-cut paper strips mean no scissors needed, so it's ideal for younger crafters.

- 60 pre-cut paper strips in green, yellow and blue
- Printed caterpillar faces
- Self-adhesive googly eyes
- Pipe cleaners and glue dots

Follow along with our [Paper Chain Caterpillar](/tutorials/paper-chain-caterpillar) tutorial.

images.alt: Caterpillar craft kit with paper strips and googly eyes

safetyNote: UKCA/CE marked. Warning: not suitable for children under 36 months. Contains small parts (googly eyes). Choking hazard. Pipe cleaners have sharp wire ends.
